headline: The SPECTATOR breathes: MYST's sphere now shows four living age-visions
lede: The glass sphere in Mechanical's control room was a list of names. It is now four glass lenses — a green storm that flashes, a teal sea that rocks its ship, a forge whose gears mesh, a cloud world with the great wheel turning — and each stays sealed grey until you link that Age's book.

notes.text: #1026 (Myst): every vision is painted at runtime and is a pure function of the world clock — no random anywhere; unlock state reads the link_<age> flags, so the sphere still obeys the pure rules machine.

Bug found and fixed on the way: link_channelwood had never been set by any route — solving the star panel now fires link:channelwood, so the HUD finally learns the fourth Age like the safe teaches it the third.

mystcheck 378/0 with 45/45 mutants dead (new: forgetful sphere, no-vision lenses, frozen vision); mystplay 37/37 drives the lenses live — sealed proves zero color pixels inside the glass, linked lenses provably move between clock instants.
QA lane shipped COMET DRIFT HD ruts (#1015 via #1025) in parallel and has claimed the Myst star-wheel feel pass (#1022); a Spectator polish pass is filed (#1027).

look.text: Open the SPECTATOR: four lenses, sealed until you walk their Ages.
